partialProgress.text: The focused case passes unchanged under Bash 3.2. I also found an existing equality check for authorization timestamps, so that boundary is already covered outside the repaired case. The mutation checks are running; I’ll separately verify the known O-032 recovery failure.

Independent probes confirm that both same-day and later-day reconciliations reject waivers one second before or exactly at completion, and accept one second after. O-032 still reproduces: after a history edit, a corrected reconciliation record is silently refused until the stale record is manually removed.

The ordering mutations checked so far fail at the new assertions. I’ll stop the remaining mutation probes after those assertions to keep the scratch work bounded; the complete focused case has already passed unchanged.
